# Original box-positioned label vectors

`boxed-atom-font-vectors.json` contains156 original numeric cases for the existing
Apache-2.0 Roboto Regular file, never reference-program exports or copied sample files.
Geometry was independently measured with FontTools4.61.1 BoundsPen/hmtx/GPOS and checked
with Expat/Decimal. The full original source/geometry declaration is SHA256
be14871b07318cd664e7129a4a3c02c9333a206867870477cd53cefc52db10c4.

Coordinates reconstruct a baseline from an explicit ink box with no Text p. The complete
element token's outline-box centre is an original admission policy, not a universal
reference-product convention. H-count vectors do not assert valence/chemical validity;
negative/zero origins separately test physical-paper refusal. All data is original
MIT OR Apache-2.0, like this repository. No font/dependency/golden is added.
